mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries allows two AuditEntry atoms for the same application to share identical (prevStatus, newStatus) pairs, which models a duplicate/overwritten chain position — exactly what AppendOnly and FR_018_AuditImmutability forbid. The injection forces such a duplicate to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj e1, e2: AuditEntry | e1.forApp = e2.forApp and e1.prevStatus = e2.prevStatus and e1.newStatus = e2.newStatus }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_NoSelfDecision allows a non-initial AuditEntry's actor to equal the application's applicant — i.e., an officer self-approves their own loan. The injection forces this to exist, which NoSelfMutation and FR_013_NoSelfApproval must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfDecisionViolation { some e: AuditEntry | some e.prevStatus and e.actor = e.forApp.applicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_NoSelfAssignment allows the assignedOfficer of an application to be the same user as the applicant. The injection forces a self-assigned application into the model, directly violating FR_011_NoSelfAssignment.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfAssignmentViolation { some a: LoanApplication | some a.assignedOfficer and a.assignedOfficer = a.applicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditEndpointAuditorOnly allows a non-auditor (e.g., an officer or applicant) to issue a GetAuditLog call, violating the audit-endpoint auditor-only restriction and the NoInformationLeakage invariant. The injection forces such a call to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditLeakViolation { some c: ApiCall | c.opKind = GetAuditLog and c.callRole = RApplicant and RApplicant in c.caller.userRoles }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_RoleMutualExclusion allows a User to simultaneously hold both ROfficer and RAuditor, which is explicitly forbidden by FR-002. The injection creates such a user, which FR_002_RoleMutualExclusion must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_RoleMutualExclusionViolation { some u: User | ROfficer in u.userRoles and RAuditor in u.userRoles }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_OneInFlightPerApplicant allows a single applicant to have two in-flight (Pending or UnderReview) applications simultaneously. The injection forces exactly this scenario, which FR_008_OneInFlightPerApplicant must catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MultipleInFlightViolation { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.applicant = a2.applicant and a1.status = Pending and a2.status = UnderReview }
